name: binhex-official-teamspeak6-server
description: TeamSpeak 6 Server (Beta). Tried and tested for nearly 25 years, TeamSpeak offers ideal voice communication for gaming, education and training, internal business communication, and staying in touch with friends and family. This is the official TeamSpeak 6 server Docker image from TeamSpeak Systems. NOTE: This is a Beta release. TeamSpeak 3 server licenses are NOT compatible with TeamSpeak 6, and there is currently no migration path from TeamSpeak 3 to TeamSpeak 6.

paths.name: Path: /config
paths.description: Container path for all TeamSpeak server data including the SQLite database, logs, crash dumps, and configuration files.

ports.name: Port: Voice
ports.description: UDP port for TeamSpeak voice communication. Clients connect to this port to join the server.

ports.name: Port: File Transfer
ports.description: TCP port used for file transfers between clients and the server. The internal container port MUST match the external host port.

ports.name: Port: Web Query
ports.description: TCP port for the HTTP Web Query interface. Enable with TSSERVER_QUERY_HTTP_ENABLED=1.

ports.name: Port: SSH Query
ports.description: TCP port for the SSH Query interface. Enable with TSSERVER_QUERY_SSH_ENABLED=1.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_LICENSE_ACCEPTED
variables.description: Set to 'accept' to confirm you have read and accepted the TeamSpeak server license agreement. The server will NOT start without this value set.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_DEFAULT_PORT
variables.description: Permanently sets the default UDP voice port for the first virtual server created. Should match the Voice port mapping above.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_FILE_TRANSFER_PORT
variables.description: TCP port used for file transfers. Must match the File Transfer port mapping above — internal and external ports MUST be identical.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_QUERY_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Override the query password for the built-in serveradmin account. If left blank, a random password is generated on first start and printed to the container logs.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_QUERY_HTTP_ENABLED
variables.description: Set to '1' to enable the HTTP Web Query interface. Also ensure the Web Query port is published above.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_QUERY_HTTP_PORT
variables.description: Port on which the HTTP Web Query interface listens. Default: 10080.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_QUERY_SSH_ENABLED
variables.description: Set to '1' to enable the SSH Query interface. Also ensure the SSH Query port is published above.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_QUERY_SSH_PORT
variables.description: Port on which the SSH Query interface listens. Default: 10022.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_DATABASE_PLUGIN
variables.description: Database backend to use. 'sqlite3' (default, no external DB needed) or 'mariadb' for a MariaDB/MySQL database.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_DATABASE_HOST
variables.description: Hostname or IP address of the MariaDB database server. Only required when TSSERVER_DATABASE_PLUGIN=mariadb.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_DATABASE_PORT
variables.description: Port of the MariaDB database server. Only required when TSSERVER_DATABASE_PLUGIN=mariadb.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_DATABASE_NAME
variables.description: Name of the database to use. Only required when TSSERVER_DATABASE_PLUGIN=mariadb.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_DATABASE_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for MariaDB authentication. Only required when TSSERVER_DATABASE_PLUGIN=mariadb.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_DATABASE_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for MariaDB authentication. Only required when TSSERVER_DATABASE_PLUGIN=mariadb.

variables.name: Variable: TSSERVER_DATABASE_CLIENT_KEEP_DAYS
variables.description: Number of days to retain client records in the database before pruning. Default: 30.
